title: Agentic Architect: An Agentic AI Framework for Architecture Design Exploration and Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2604.25083v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Computer Architecture research has traditionally required the exploration of vast, highly complex design spaces through manual human effort. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer an opportunity to accelerate this process by enabling fast and automated implementation and testing of different architectural mechanisms and their combinations. We introduce Agentic Architect, a framework for agentic CPU microarchitectural design-space exploration and optimization. The Agentic Architect combines LLM-driven code evolution with cycle-accurate simulation and hardware cost modeling to explore performance, area, and power tradeoffs. Starting from a seed design, the LLM is prompted to explore the design space by implementing changes, guided by prior evaluation feedback. translated_title: 智能体架构师：一个用于架构设计探索与优化的智能体AI框架
translated_abstract: 计算机体系结构研究传统上需要依靠人工去探索庞大且高度复杂的设计空间。大语言模型（LLM）为加速这一过程提供了机会，能够快速、自动化地实现和测试不同的体系结构机制及其组合。我们提出了Agentic Architect，一个用于智能体式CPU微体系结构设计空间探索与优化的框架。该框架将LLM驱动的代码演化与周期精确仿真和硬件成本建模相结合，以探索性能、面积和功耗之间的权衡。从一个种子设计出发，LLM在先前评估反馈的引导下，通过实现各种设计改动来探索设计空间。每个新设计都会被编译、在训练工作负载上进行仿真、依据优化目标进行评估，并受到面积和功耗预算的约束。其得分和诊断信息将更新（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出Agentic Architect框架，将大语言模型驱动的代码演化与周期精确仿真及硬件成本建模相结合，实现了CPU微体系结构设计空间的自动化探索，并对性能、面积和功耗进行权衡优化。
en_tdlr: Proposes Agentic Architect, a framework that combines LLM-driven code evolution with cycle-accurate simulation and hardware cost modeling to enable automated CPU microarchitectural design-space exploration and optimization of performance, area, and power tradeoffs.
